text:
Izzy: Hey all  day 1! Quick Qs: where's the place to post a quick intro vs a company-wide hello? Also how do I silence non-critical bots for nights?
Kai: welcome Izzy :tada: intro -> post short bio in #new-hires (pinned template), company-wide -> #general if you want everyone to see. Team intro -> your team channel.
Izzy: got it. about bot noise  can I snooze specific apps only at night?
devex-bot: Use `/dnd schedule 22:00-07:00` to set your DND and then in channel settings -> Apps -> mute app notifications. For recurring bot digests, enable digest mode in the app settings. Do not mute #incidents or #eng-oncall.
Izzy: perfect. one more: where are pinned onboarding links?
Kai: pinned in #new-hires and also in #devex. quick ones: https://docs.redwood.ai/onboarding/slack-guides and https://intra.redwood/new-hire-checklist.
onboarding-buddy: sent the checklist and calendar invites. I'll run a 30-min channel walkthrough at 3pm.
Izzy: amazing, thanks everyone! :thumbsup:
